poll.question: Should Dan open the ramp for Hui Ling's injured birds, or hold the seal tight?

options.label: Open the ramp
options.desc: Trust her instinct. What she's choosing to be matters more than his protocols.

options.label: Hold the seal
options.desc: Keep it locked. Survival means the hard no—even to her.

options.label: Make a deal
options.desc: Both their instincts are right. Help the birds without breaking the seal.

in_play.label: Talk before opening
in_play.desc: Neither fully wins — one tense conversation through the door to decide
